name: Big Ben
description: Big Ben generally refers to the Elizabeth Tower, which is the clock tower of the Palace of Westminster, one of the world's famous Gothic buildings, and the nickname of the large clock in the Clock Tower attached to the British Parliament Chamber. It is a clock tower located on the banks of the Thames in London, England. It is one of London's landmark buildings. The bell tower is 95 meters high, the bell is 9 feet in diameter and weighs 13.5 tons. It rings the Westminster bell every 15 minutes. Since the construction of the Jubilee Line, Big Ben has been affected, with measurements showing it tilts about half a meter to the northwest.
